units.source_text: 若是這樣，倒是輕鬆。然而，所謂的人真的就如此滿足了嗎？

en.t: If that were so, life would be easy. And yet, are so-called human beings truly satisfied with just that?

units.source_text: 我不明白。……他們不是夜間酣然入睡，早晨起來神清氣爽嗎？

en.t: I do not understand. Do they not sleep soundly at night and wake in the morning feeling refreshed?

units.source_text: 都做了哪些夢呢？他們會邊走路邊想什麼嗎？是錢嗎？

en.t: What sort of dreams do they have? What do they think about as they walk along? Money?

units.source_text: 不可能只會是這樣吧？儘管我好像聽說過「人為食而生」，

en.t: Surely it cannot be only that. Although I feel I have heard the saying that people live in order to eat,

units.source_text: 但從未耳聞過「人為錢而活」。

en.t: I have never heard anyone say that people live for money.

units.source_text: 不，雖然存在因事而論……不，我還是弄不明白。……

en.t: No, though perhaps it depends on the situation. No, I still cannot understand it.

units.source_text: 越想我就變得越是糊塗，最終使我陷入類似於古怪人的不安與恐懼之中。

en.t: The more I thought about it, the more confused I became, until at last I was plunged into the anxiety and terror of feeling like some strange oddity.

units.source_text: 我幾乎無法與旁人交談，因為我不知道說什麼，該說些什麼。

en.t: I could hardly speak with other people, because I did not know what to say or how I ought to say it.

units.source_text: 於是我想出了一招，那就是搞笑。

en.t: So I came up with one device: making people laugh.
